privates.name: k.u.k. Post
privates.description: Always assigned to the Luka. The Luka starts with $200 in its treasury. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Public Line Bond
privates.description: One per player, dealt at setup; not auctioned. Can't be sold. From the 4H phase, exchange in a stock round for a reserved 10% Public Line share; forced exchange on the first 4+. Reserved shares pay the Public Line's treasury.

privates.name: Public Line Bond

privates.name: Ganz Locomotive Works
privates.description: Sell to any company for $1–100. The owning company may close it at any point in its turn to buy one train from the supply at full price, like Wiener Neustadt. Closes when used or on the first 4+.

privates.name: Kupa River Bridge
privates.description: Blocks one Kupa hex (owner's choice). May be exchanged for a reserved Shortline share in a stock round. Forced exchange on the first 4+.

privates.name: Pazin Tunnel Company
privates.description: May be exchanged for a reserved Shortline share in a stock round. Forced exchange on the first 4+.

privates.name: Zadar Station Rights
privates.description: Blocks Zadar. The owning company may lay or upgrade Zadar without a connection, as one of its tile lays or its upgrade (not both in one turn); if it does, it may place its cheapest station there free, as its station for that OR. At 4–5 players one of P3/P4 is removed at random. Closes on the first 4+. From 4H, may be sold to a company for ½×–1× face.

privates.name: Virovitica Station Rights
privates.description: Blocks Virovitica. The owning company may lay or upgrade Virovitica without a connection, as one of its tile lays or its upgrade (not both in one turn); if it does, it may place its cheapest station there free, as its station for that OR. At 4–5 players one of P3/P4 is removed at random. Closes on the first 4+. From 4H, may be sold to a company for ½×–1× face.

privates.name: Rijeka Lazaretto
privates.description: Quarantine: once, when a rust would remove a train of a company you preside, that train runs once more, then is removed. It can't be traded in or sold. May be used on the first 4+'s rust. Closes when used or on the first 4+.

privates.name: Kvarner Shipbuilding
privates.description: May be exchanged for a reserved Shortline share in a stock round. Forced exchange on the first 4+.

privates.name: Lika Survey Office
privates.description: Holds the only straight yellow tile. Any company the owner presides may lay it as a normal tile lay. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Slavonian Agricultural Society
privates.description: Comes with a 10% Mainline share. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Wiener Neustadt Locomotive Works
privates.description: From 4H, may be sold to a non-Luka company for $1–200. The owning company may close this to buy a train from the supply at any point in its turn. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Sava Steam Ferry
privates.description: Comes with a 10% Mainline share. Closes on the first 4+.

privates.name: Austrian Bank
privates.description: Comes with one Mainline share and one random Luka-company share. Never closes or sells. Once per SR the owner buys one certificate or starts a company for it, paying what it can't.

privates.name: Narodna Concession
privates.description: Comes with the 20% president's certificate of the Public Line (third Luka company drawn), which starts at 86 like the Shortline. Every player starts with a Public Line Bond. The Public Line floats when 60% is out of the bank, reserved Bond shares included, and then takes $860 (10 × 86) from the bank. Closes when the Public Line operates.

privates.name: Hungarian Bank
privates.description: No income. Comes with a Public Line share; works as a second Austrian Bank. Until the first 2+, may convert into Ganz during a stock round, as a free action on the owner's turn: its cash and shares go to the owner, who sells down to 60% and the cert limit.

privates.name: MÁV Concession
privates.description: Comes with the 20% president's certificate of the Mainline (first Luka company drawn). Closes when the Mainline operates.

privates.name: Südbahn Concession
privates.description: Comes with the 20% president's certificate of the Shortline (second Luka company drawn). Closes when the Shortline operates.

privates.name: Ancona Steamship Line
privates.description: From the first OR, may be sold to a non-Luka company for ½×–1× face. The buying company places its cheapest station on Ancona, free (no connection needed, not its station for the OR); for the rest of the game its routes to Ancona add the largest other stop. Closes when sold or on the first 4+.

trains.description: Runs once more after the Diesel

turns.name: Stock Round
steps: Sell (at most 30% of one company per turn)
One action: buy, start a Luka company (or a Branch in the Late space), split, or act for the Austrian Bank or Hungarian Bank
optional: Free: private exchanges, Hungarian Bank conversion (until 2+)

phases.notes: Public Line Bonds may be exchanged
Hungarian Bank can no longer convert
